events.title: MAS TRM Guidelines: What They Ask of Threat Intelligence and Third Parties
events.summary: Singapore's financial regulator, MAS, publishes Technology Risk Management Guidelines that set technology risk expectations for banks and financial institutions, including requirements around threat intelligence and third-party management. The record notes the current edition was published on 18 of an unspecified month.
events.why_it_matters: The guidelines define regulator-set technology risk obligations for financial institutions in Singapore, covering threat intelligence and third-party oversight. Defenders in firms operating under MAS supervision would need to align their programmes with these expectations. The record does not state whether it affects any Australian entities.
